title: SOC2 rehearsal checklist + prep notes (Riley)
content:
Purpose: quick run-through before the Tue audit call. Focus = make auditors' first 20 minutes smooth: scope, ownership, where evidence lives, and known gaps. This is messy — notes to self + live checklist for the rehearsal.

Meeting goal:
- Validate control owners know what to present (access, change mgmt, backups, vendor mgmt, incident mgmt).
- Confirm evidence links and that there are no missing screenshots / hashes.
- Rehearse answers to likely auditor questions (encryption key custody, patch windows, incident timeline).

Attendees (target): Riley (me), Ana (controls), Devon (infra), Priya (compliance reviewer), Lena (platform eng backup), external: audit firm rep (tentative).

Agenda (30m):
1) 0-5m intro: scope & timeline (I will run)
2) 5-12m access controls: who shows the console (Devon) + MFA proof (screenshot)
3) 12-18m change mgmt: PR -> deploy -> monitoring (Ana) + sample ticket (JIRA-DEP-908)
4) 18-24m vendor mgmt & KMS: vendor questionnaire status (Riley) + AWS KMS rotation policy (doc link)
5) 24-28m evidence handoff: where auditors pull artifacts (Confluence evidence tracker)
6) 28-30m quick recap + action items (me)

Quick control status snapshot (my callouts):
- Logical access (AC): evidence = org SSO SCIM config, 3 recent user add/removal events exported, MFA rollout screenshot. STATUS: evidence assembled but need last 90d export for auditor (MISSING). OWNER: Devon.
- Change management (CM): evidence = PR -> ticket link -> deploy runbook -> deployment audit log. STATUS: representative PRs exist; need signed approval record for 2025-11 major change (MISSING). OWNER: Ana.
- Backup & restore (BCR): evidence = backup runbook, last successful restore test notes (2026-01-18). STATUS: good, but ask SRE to attach restore logs. OWNER: Lena.
- Encryption & key mgmt (EKM): evidence = KMS policy, key rotation schedule, HSM usage note. STATUS: documentation up-to-date; auditor may ask about BYO key for Private customers. OWNER: Riley.
- Vendor risk (VR): top vendors list + completed questionnaires. STATUS: Datadog OK, AWS OK, Third-party auth (AuthX) questionnaire incomplete (MISSING). OWNER: Riley -> follow up with vendor ops.
- Monitoring & incident mgmt (IM): incident runbook, 2025 incident postmortem summary. STATUS: postmortem sanitized; need timeline logs for the 2025-07 incident (MISSING). OWNER: Priya.

Evidence links to verify before call (add to Confluence evidence tracker):
- SSO SCIM export CSV -> /confluence/evidence/scim-export-2026-02.csv
- PR/Jira sample: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/JIRA-DEP-908 (include approval thread)
- Backup test notes: /confluence/evidence/restore-2026-01-18.md
- KMS policy doc: /confluence/security/kms-rotation-v3.md
- Vendor questionnaire (AuthX): /confluence/vendors/authx-questionnaire-draft.md

Mock auditor Q&A (prep lines):
Q: "How do you control privileged access to the KMS keys?"
A (short): "We use AWS KMS with an IAM-bound key policy. Privileged key actions are restricted to a small role (key-admin) and enforced via SSO groups. All key usage is logged in CloudTrail and mirrored to immutable storage for 90 days. See KMS policy doc + CloudTrail sample events. (Follow-up: show a CloudTrail sample event and the policy snippet.)"

Q: "Show us evidence of change approvals for a production deploy."
A (short): "Approval is captured in Jira ticket comment + signed off in the PR via CODEOWNERS approver. We'll open JIRA-DEP-908 as the example and show the PR with approval timestamp. If pressed, we can also show pipeline run that blocks if approval missing."

Rehearsal notes (real-time to capture):
- Devon: please share SCIM export before EOD Mon (I need to attach).
- Ana: dig for the 2025-11 approval; might be in personal inbox — if not, mark as gap and prepare mitigation note.
- Lena: upload restore logs and ensure timestamps are human-readable.
- Priya: redact PII from postmortem but preserve timeline.

Unresolved questions to raise in prep:
- Do we have a signed BA with AuthX? (if not, escalate to Vendor Ops)
- For Private deployments, do we have a documented process for customer-supplied keys? (I think we have an engineering design doc but not a policy.)
- Confirm retention window for CloudTrail exports used for KMS events (is it 90 days or 180 days?).

Action items (owner — due):
- [ ] Devon: export last 90d SCIM events and upload to confluence evidence tracker (due 2026-03-11)
- [ ] Ana: locate or recreate approval evidence for 2025-11 major change; if not available, draft remediation timeline (due 2026-03-12)
- [ ] Riley: finish vendor questionnaire for AuthX and ping vendor-ops for BA status (due 2026-03-11)
- [ ] Lena: attach restore logs + screenshots of successful restore into evidence tracker (due 2026-03-11)
- [ ] Priya: produce redacted incident timeline for 2025-07 incident (due 2026-03-12)
- [ ] All: join Tue rehearsal at 10:00 PT and be prepared to share screens (calendar invite sent)

Post-rehearsal follow-ups (if auditors ask for extras):
- Provide a short write-up explaining any recreated evidence and the rationale for re-creation.
- If a vendor BA is missing for a high-risk vendor, escalate to legal + vendor ops and provide temporary compensating controls (e.g., restricted access, additional monitoring).

Notes to self: keep answers concise, avoid long internal backstory in the first pass. If auditor wants detail — offer to table and follow up with a short artifact pack. Use the evidence tracker links as the single source of truth.

End of doc — quick checklist status when leaving rehearsal:
- SCIM export (Y/N): pending
- 2025 approval (Y/N): pending
- Restore logs (Y/N): pending->in progress
- AuthX questionnaire (Y/N): draft
- Postmortem timeline redaction (Y/N): pending

If anything gets urgent overnight, slack me (riley.chen) and tag #sec-audit-run.

-- Riley
